QuestInfo.name: Neinheart's Secret Mission
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has a favor to ask, but he wants you to keep it secret.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart gave you a secret mission to protect Empress Cygnus. You need to gather #b#e50 Curse Eye Tails#k#n to create a barrier so those who wish her harm can't get near. They can be found at the Green Tree Trunks and Tree Trunk Nest 1 in Ellinia.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart gave you a secret mission to protect Empress Cygnus. You needed to gather materials to create a barrier so those who wish her harm can't get near, and you brought him all the materials.

0.0: I have need of you, but it must be kept secret. The forces of darkness seem more directed as of late. We must ensure the Empress's safety. I need you to gather materials to reinforce the barrier around Cygnus.

no.0: I will not trust anyone else with this task. Come back when you're ready.

0.1: You need to gather #b#e50 Curse Eye Tails#k#n for the barrier. I'll send you to #b#m101030100##k, where the Curse Eyes are.

1.0: Do not tell a soul what I've told you, not even Empress Cygnus herself. Anyone could be a spy.

item.0: Bring me #b#e50 Curse Eye Tails#k#n. It will require a trip to the Green Tree Trunk and Tree Trunk Nest 1 in Ellinia. Please hurry back.
